response.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) FROM trans WHERE date > '1996-05-09' AND date < '1998-01-06' AND type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')

assumptions.assumption: trans.date is stored as an ISO-formatted date string (YYYY-MM-DD), so string comparison with the literal bounds correctly excludes both end dates.
Rows with type VYBER or NULL are excluded from the average entirely (both numerator and denominator), as the request says to leave them out.
